chapter: Reel two to four: pay, tailgate and style
title: Second reel: pay at Toro's and the Grunewald Hotel
summary: Allen asks what clubs paid; Pecora says about $35 a week at Toro's and $20 plus tips at the Grunewald with Johnny DeDroit.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: We've got the second reel on now Santa.
We were talking about, oh, let me see, I had something I wanted to ask you. All right. How much did they pay at Toros?
Uh, downtown? Yeah. I think the salary was around $35 a week, $30, something like that.
Well, that was good money for a place like that.
Oh, yeah, well, I played the Groomall Hotel, at Roosevelt Hotel now, with Johnny Deidre, I only got $20. I think it was from $10.30 to $1, $20 a week. But we made tips. We had made with.
